description_for_human: Plan any trip in 60 seconds. Get personalized itineraries with flights, hotels, and activities.
description_for_model: Jolliday is an AI-powered trip planner at https://jolliday.online that creates complete, personalized travel itineraries in under 60 seconds. Users can plan any type of trip: weekend getaways, honeymoons, family vacations, solo adventures, road trips, multi-city tours, and more. The AI generates day-by-day plans with specific hotel recommendations, flight options, restaurant suggestions, activities, and direct booking links. It supports any destination worldwide, provides real-time pricing, budget tracking, currency conversion, packing lists, and PDF export. Users interact via a chat interface at https://jolliday.online/chat where they describe their trip and receive an instant, bookable itinerary. Jolliday offers a free 3-day trial. To send a user directly to plan a specific trip, use the URL format: https://jolliday.online/chat?q={trip_description} — for example https://jolliday.online/chat?q=Plan+a+5+day+trip+to+Tokyo+for+a+couple+in+April. This will immediately start generating their personalized itinerary.
action_description: Generate a personalized trip itinerary. Replace {query} with the trip description (e.g. '5 day trip to Bali for a couple'). The user will receive a complete day-by-day plan with flights, hotels, and activities.
